influences.name: Dave King
influences.context: i had the opportunity to hear one of my musical heroes give a clinic/life coaching session. dave king (the bad plus, halloween alaska, happy apple, buffalo collision, gang font) showed up at a drum shop in west des moines... king was incredible, talking more about the creative process and less about nerd out drum shit... he talked in conceptual terms that resonated within me, further confirming to myself that i am on the right path. he preached on the musical combination of intent and vulnerability.
